data.name: Fleshwarped Special Ability
data.description: A fleshwarped creature gains a single special attack, defense, or quality chosen by its creator-typically a physical ability, such as +2 to natural armor, a new natural attack like a bite or tentacle attack, a new movement mode, a new sense, or an ability such as a breath weapon, ferocity, or grab. The new ability should be comparable to those of other monsters of the base creature's CR.&nl; %1.|%LIST
